name: 19444 · Lafayette Hl, PA
findings: ZIP 19444 (Lafayette Hl) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (71%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19444 (Lafayette Hl) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
